1.mascotDialogue: Same visited-tracking idea as BFS, beta, but a completely different order of operations! DFS dives deep first, and only comes back up when it truly, absolutely has to.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 6 is the whole difference from BFS, beta — instead of queuing the neighbor for later, DFS recurses into it immediately, going deep before it ever comes back to check the next sibling.

3.mascotDialogue: Same graph as the BFS lesson, beta, completely different order — 3 gets visited before 2, because DFS committed to going through 1 first and rode that path all the way down, no looking back.

4.mascotDialogue: DFS's recursive elegance is also its biggest risk, beta — forget the visited check, and 'go deep' has no bottom to hit at all. It just keeps calling itself, forever and ever.
